title: Nourishing Japanese Chicken Breasts Chirashi
description: A high-protein and adventurous Japanese dish featuring slow-cooked chicken breasts served over a bed of Japanese rice, this Nourishing Japanese Chicken Breasts Chirashi is perfect for a weeknight dinner. It combines the flavors of Japan with the comfort of a slow-cooked meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large saucepan, combine dashi broth, soy sauce, mirin, and sake, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to low and add the chicken breasts, cooking for 20 minutes or until they reach an internal temperature of 165 degrees Fahrenheit.
While the chicken is cooking, prepare the Japanese rice according to the package instructions.
Once the chicken is cooked, remove it from the saucepan and let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing it into thin strips.

To assemble the chirashi, place a scoop of Japanese rice onto a plate or lazy-susan-spinner, followed by a few slices of the chicken and a sprinkle of green onions, sesame seeds, and shichimi togarashi.
Drizzle the remaining sauce from the saucepan over the top of the chicken and rice.
